stratum: Forward realization and state/effect readout comparison: retain all five labelled four-component filler records, then compare their conditional balanced-port record with the entire existing Bell sequential instrument. A supplied instrument is not a derivation of probabilities from Gram rank.
consumes: existing photon Bell packet and independent record-descent result
next_falsifier: Reject if repaired source norms disagree with their full-vector synthesis, if actual states fail to change joint records, or if the imported instrument comparison loses its continuations. A source-derived preparation/probability/record law is separate; neither another compatible Gram nor a new normalization supplies it. The phase-family target test is restricted to the actual equal-path source and fixed CHSH analyzers, not all quantum preparations.
